test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the genome-edited rice variety developed to improve yield and productivity in May 2025?

options.text: Malaviya Manila Sinchit Dhan-1 and Pusa Basmati 1121
DRR Dhan 100 (Kamala) and Pusa DST Rice 1

solution:
The correct answer is __**DRR Dhan 100 (Kamala) and Pusa DST Rice 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **DRR Dhan 100 (Kamala)** and **Pusa DST Rice 1** are genome-edited rice varieties developed in May 2025 to improve yield and productivity.
 
• Both varieties utilize genome editing technologies such as CRISPR/Cas9 to enhance traits like drought tolerance and pest resistance.
 
• The development of these varieties aligns with India's focus on leveraging advanced biotechnology for sustainable agricultural practices.
 
• These rice varieties are designed to address challenges such as climate change and diminishing arable land while boosting food security.
 
• Genome editing in agriculture involves precise modifications to specific genes without introducing foreign DNA, ensuring safety and consumer acceptance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genome Editing:** Genome editing involves precise changes to the DNA of an organism, enabling targeted enhancements without introducing foreign DNA.
 
• **CRISPR/Cas9 Technology:** A revolutionary genome editing tool that allows researchers to edit specific genes with high accuracy and efficiency.
 
• **Benefits of Genome-edited Crops:** Include improved yield, resistance to pests, tolerance to environmental stress, and reduced reliance on chemical fertilizers.
 
• **Importance in Food Security:** Such advancements contribute significantly to addressing food shortages and ensuring sustainable agricultural practices in the face of climate change.
 
• **Regulation of Genome-edited Crops:** Countries adopt varying regulatory frameworks, with India emphasizing safety, environmental sustainability, and public acceptance in agricultural biotechnology.
